messages:
Priya: Heads-up — Acme QBR prep. We're seeing a 2.8x embed spike last 48h, potential runway hit. Can ops pull an env-split forecast by EOD?
Ava: saw that, looks like most burn is from nightly batch jobs in staging. tagging infra to confirm.
Diego: can you paste the last 7d burn by env? don't want surprises in the QBR deck.
Liam: quick thought — prefix caching + conservative batching could drop token cost fast. Should be a 1-day change.
Priya: putting action items: 1) 7d burn table, 2) 30d projection at current cadence, 3) mitigation playbook / enablement slide (owner Liam).
Ava: I'll start a one-pager "enablement-lite" for the customer with step-by-step cost mitigations and runbook snippets.
Diego: pasted quick numbers from billing (prelim):
```
7d total tokens: 12.4M
daily avg: 1.77M
projected 30d @ current cadence: 53.1M tokens
```
Priya: good. Can we also simulate a 30% reduction scenario (caching+batches) and show cost delta for QBR?
Liam: yes — rough estimate: 30% token reduction -> projected ~37M tokens for 30d. I'll include before/after numbers and simple assumptions.
onboarding-bot: Reminder: QBR deck due in 3 days for account 'acme' (owner: Priya).
Priya: assigning: @Liam create mitigation runbook + config snippets; @Ava draft slide with before/after numbers and customer-friendly wording; @Diego validate pricing/model assumptions and expected $ impact. I'll coordinate the pre-read.
Diego: also flagging renewal risk: customer noted budget tightening for next quarter — if burn continues we should mark renewal risk as 'medium' and prepare contingency ask.
Ava: ops question — can we set a budget alert at 65% of current credits to trigger outreach? That'd give us runway to engage proactively.
Liam: yes, I'll request account-level alert + a temporary non-blocking throttle policy to curtail spikes. ETA: EOD.
Priya: customer feedback to capture: "responses feel slower during bursts" — add latency note and tradeoff options to the QBR (caching vs model/latency).
Diego: noted. I'll produce a short cost vs latency tradeoff table and drop it into the deck.
Priya: if mitigation goes well, we'll include an optional paid burst pack / reserved cushion ask in the QBR to reduce renewal friction.
Liam: added that slide outline. Anything else?
Priya: quick sync tomorrow 10:00am to finalize numbers and rehearse QBR talking points.
Ava: :thumbsup:
Diego: :+1:
